notes: The phone app shows a Phototek server's library (src-tauri/src/mobile.rs); it builds and runs in the iOS simulator and the Android emulator.
What's New is unused on a first submission: it starts with 1.0.1.
Demo server up on 2026-11-28 at https://demo-phototek.webcms.lu (web/k8s/demo); the app's first screen has “Try the demo”.
Privacy page live on 2026-11-28: https://phototek.webcms.lu/privacy/ (English, French, German; web/public/privacy/).

holds.text: Price: free, with a one-time unlock (about 9.99 €) for automatic upload, freeing up space, memories with music and videos. The in-app purchase isn't built yet.
